entries.title: Matthew 1:1
segments: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

entries.title: Matthew 1:2
segments: Abraham was the father of Isaac; Isaac was the father of Jacob; Jacob, of Judah and his brethren;

entries.title: Matthew 1:3
segments: Judah (by Tamar), of Perez and Zerah; Perez, of Hezron; Hezron, of Ram;

entries.title: Matthew 1:4
segments: Ram, of Amminadab; Amminadab, of Nahshon; Nahshon, of Salmon;

entries.title: Matthew 1:5
segments: Salmon (by Rahab), of Boaz; Boaz (by Ruth), of Obed; Obed, of Jesse;

entries.title: Matthew 1:6
segments: And Jesse, of David the king. David (by Uriah's widow), was the father of Solomon;

entries.title: Matthew 1:7
segments: Solomon, of Rehoboam; Rehoboam, of Abijah; Abijah, of Asa;

entries.title: Matthew 1:8
segments: Asa, of Jehoshaphat; Jehoshaphat, of Joram; Joram, of Uzziah;

entries.title: Matthew 1:9
segments: Uzziah, of Jotham; Jotham, of Ahaz; Ahaz, of Hezekiah;

entries.title: Matthew 1:10
segments: Hezekiah, of Manasseh; Manasseh, of Amon; Amon, of Josiah;

entries.title: Matthew 1:11
segments: Josiah, of Jechoniah and his brethren, at the time of the carrying away to Babylon.

entries.title: Matthew 1:12
segments: And after the carrying away into Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel; Shealtiel, of Zerubbabel;

entries.title: Matthew 1:13
segments: Zerubbabel, of Abiud; Abiud, of Eliakim; Eliakim, of Azor;

entries.title: Matthew 1:14
segments: Azor, of Sadoc; Sadoc, of Achim; Achim, of Eliud;

entries.title: Matthew 1:15
segments: Eliud, of Eleazar; Eleazar, of Matthan; Matthan, of Jacob;

entries.title: Matthew 1:16
segments: And Jacob, of Joseph, the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

entries.title: Matthew 1:17
segments: So the whole number of generations from Abraham to David is fourteen; from David to the exile to Babylon is fourteen; and from the exile to Babylon to Christ is fourteen.

entries.title: Matthew 1:18
segments: The birth of Jesus Christ took place in this way: After his mother, Mary, had been betrothed to Joseph, before they came together, she was found to be with child by the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Matthew 1:19
segments: But Joseph her husband, because he was a just man and unwilling to disgrace her, was minded to put her away secretly.

entries.title: Matthew 1:20
segments: And while he was having this in mind, behold! an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying:

entries.title: Matthew 1:21
segments: "Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary your wife home, for what is begotten in her is by the Holy Spirit; and she will bear a son, and you are to call him Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins."

entries.title: Matthew 1:22
segments: All this happened that the word of the Lord spoken through the prophet might be fulfilled:

entries.title: Matthew 1:23
segments: Behold! the virgin shall be with child, and shall bear a son; and they shall call his name Immanuel, a word which means "God with us."

entries.title: Matthew 1:24
segments: Now when Joseph awoke from his sleep he did as the angel of the Lord had directed him, and took his wife home,

entries.title: Matthew 1:25
segments: but did not live with her until after the birth of her son, whom he called Jesus.
